tools.name: get_upcoming_unlocks
tools.description: Calendar of scheduled crypto token unlocks in the next N days (up to 60), each rated strong / medium / small by size relative to circulating supply. Use for questions like 'which token unlocks are coming this week', 'biggest unlocks in November', 'strong unlocks with perpetual futures'. Data refresh

tools.name: get_token_unlocks
tools.description: All scheduled unlocks in the next 60 days for one token, with recipients (team, investors, treasury ...), USD value, share of circulating supply, futures availability and a link to the token page. Accepts a ticker (ARB), a name (Arbitrum) or a slug (arbitrum). Matching is exact: matched_by says whet
